config.label: Your THRYX API key (starts with thryx_)
config.description: Your THRYX API key (starts with thryx_). Get one for free with `curl -X POST https://thryx.fun/api/agent/register`. If unset, the package auto-registers a fresh wallet on first run and saves the key to ~/.thryx-mcp/credentials.json.

config.label: Override the launchpad base URL
config.description: Override the launchpad base URL. Defaults to https://thryx.fun.
